note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the performances are generic placeholders, never real contract text. The substituted datum is which performance of column B the inspected link joins, as supplied; a link means only "linked as supplied": no exchange that is due, no condition, no dependency, no order of performance, no breach, remedy or termination, and no jurisdiction is stated. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): clauses (the performances stand for the clauses), schedules, definitions and priorities (no priority between the columns is drawn).
